title: More model choice, and better control over output
summary:
New text and speech models, broader API compatibility, a dated News changelog, and a CLI that is a little harder to fool.

Claude Haiku 5.5 and StepFun Step 5 Preview were added as paid-only text models, both with million-token context windows. Qwen Audio 3.0 TTS Flash was added as the replacement for Qwen3-TTS Instruct Flash ahead of the older model’s October 10 retirement, with instruction-guided speech and more voices. A separate fix keeps 9:16 p-video requests vertical and maps Recraft Vector dimensions to supported ratios; the audio model documentation was regenerated.

Every Chat text model now supports `/v1/responses` through either its native endpoint or an adapter. Community publishers can register text endpoints that do not stream; callers still receive a completed-answer event stream, and model listings identify the capability. Floret now accepts model preferences in `metadata` and can identify Quest-compatible models conversationally. Agent Skills discovery makes the polli skill findable from the Gen site. Fixes preserve Gemini tool-call signatures, accept array tool parameters without `items`, improve usage reporting for cache writes, and let large generation uploads pass through the coordinator.

Enter’s News work moved toward a shared index and a dated Changelog for model and API changes, including changed capabilities and revised retirement dates. The monthly Quest leaderboard now shows daily rank movement and podium medals, with a corrected Pollen amount for breaking ties. A Quest contribution added Pi Workbench, which runs Pi in a browser sandbox with project editing and preview tools. Community work also added a Japanese business-writing app to the catalog, expanded community-model publisher access, and made Polli more explicit about Discord history it could not verify.

daily.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 added
daily.text: Use `anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5` for text and image input, tools, adaptive reasoning, and a million-token context window. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5).

daily.title: Step 5 Preview added
daily.text: `stepfun/step-5-preview` accepts text and images and supports tool calls, structured output, and a million-token context window. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=stepfun/step-5-preview).

daily.title: Qwen speech replacement added
daily.text: `qwen/qwen-audio-3.0-tts-flash` was added to replace Qwen3-TTS Instruct Flash ahead of its October 10 retirement. It supports instruction-guided emotion, tone, and dialect, plus 12 system voices. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=qwen/qwen-audio-3.0-tts-flash).

daily.title: Responses across text models
daily.text: Use `/v1/responses` with every text model that supports Chat Completions, including Claude, Gemini, and Chat-registered community models. Models without a native Responses endpoint are adapted through the Chat pipeline. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Publish non-streaming text models
daily.text: Community publishers can register Chat Completions or Responses endpoints that return JSON without token-by-token streaming. Model listings expose `supports_streaming: false`, so callers can tell when an answer will arrive at once. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Choose Floret’s inner model
daily.text: Send `metadata.model` to choose Floret’s inner text model. Floret can also check `paid_only` when you ask it to prefer Quest-compatible models; that preference is conversational, not a restriction. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Discover the polli skill
daily.text: Compatible Agent Skills installers can discover the existing polli CLI skill from `gen.pollinations.ai` through its new well-known index. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: A dated Enter Changelog
daily.text: Enter’s News page groups model and API changes by date and shows what changed, including capabilities, access, voices, and revised retirement dates. Daily highlights appear alongside it. [Visit Enter](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: Quest ranks have movement
daily.text: The monthly Quest leaderboard now shows places gained or lost since 00:00 UTC, marks new participants, and gives the top three ranks podium medals. [Visit Pollinations](https://pollinations.ai).

daily.title: Pi in a browser workbench
daily.text: Pi Workbench runs Pi in a browser sandbox with a project editor, terminal, HTML preview, and ZIP downloads. Visitors can use a Pollinations key or authorize their wallet for model calls.
